The disciples confirmed, 'The Lord has truly risen' (Luke 24:34). Paul distinguishes 'truly' widows from those with family support (1 Tim 5:3,5,16) and urges Timothy to lay hold of 'that which is truly life' (1 Tim 6:19). Translations converge on emphatic affirmation: Spanish 'verdaderamente,' German 'wirklich,' French 'vraiment/reellement,' Hindi 'sachmuch/vaastav men,' Korean 'chamuro/jinsillo,' Swahili 'kweli,' Arabic 'haqqan.'"
